message.content:
Here’s a balanced mix of compound lifts, isolation moves, and body‑weight exercises that target all the major leg muscles (quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, and hip stabilizers). Pick 3–4 from each category and combine them into a 45–60‑minute workout, or use them as part of a split routine. | Category | Exercise | Primary Muscles | Tips | |----------|----------|-----------------|------| | **Compound Lifts** | • **Back Squat**
• **Front Squat**
• **Deadlift** (conventional or sumo)
• **Hip Thrust**
• **Bulgarian Split Squat** | Quads, hamstrings, glutes, core | Keep your core tight, maintain neutral spine, and use a spotter for heavy sets. | | **Isolation / Hypertrophy** | • **Leg Press**
• **Romanian Deadlift**
• **Hamstring Curl** (lying or seated)
• **Leg Extension**
• **Calf Raise** (standing or seated) | Targeted muscle groups | Use controlled tempo (3–4 seconds eccentric, 1–2 seconds concentric). | | **Body‑Weight / Functional** | • **Pistol Squat** (assisted if needed)
• **Jump Squat**
• **Step‑Up** (with or without weight)
• **Glute Bridge** (single‑leg or weighted)
• **Lateral Lunge** | Full lower body, hip abductors | Focus on form; add resistance bands or dumbbells for extra load. | | **Stability / Core** | • **Single‑Leg Romanian Deadlift**
• **Goblet Squat**
• **Kettlebell Swing**
• **Farmer’s Walk** (with dumbbells or kettlebells) | Glutes, hamstrings, core, grip | Keep shoulders back, avoid rounding the lower back. | ### Sample 4‑Week Progression | Week | Sets | Reps | Load | Focus | |------|------|------|------|-------| | 1 | 3 | 12 | 50 % 1RM | Volume, form | | 2 | 4 | 10 | 60 % 1RM | Strength | | 3 | 5 | 8 | 70 % 1RM | Hypertrophy | | 4 | 3 | 5 | 80 % 1RM | Max strength | - **Warm‑up**: 5–10 min light cardio + dynamic stretches (leg swings, hip circles). - **Cool‑down**: 5–10 min light cardio + static stretches (hamstring stretch, quad stretch). - **Recovery**: 48 h rest between heavy leg sessions; consider foam rolling or massage. ### Quick “Leg‑Day” Routine (≈45 min) 1. **Back Squat** – 4 × 8 2. **Romanian Deadlift** – 3 × 10 3. **Leg Press** – 3 × 12 4. **Calf Raise** – 4 × 15 5. **Glute Bridge** – 3 × 20 (body‑weight) Finish with a 5‑minute walk or light jog to flush out lactic acid. Feel free to swap in variations (e.g., sumo deadlift, hack squat) or add plyometrics (box jumps) once you’re comfortable with the basics. Happy training!
